title: Battle of Andros (1825)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Andros (1825)", at revision 1370432032, opens: "The Battle of Andros took place on 1 June 1825 at Andros between the fleets of the Ottoman Empire and Revolutionary Greece. The Greek fleet, under Georgios Sachtouris, comprising 20 warships and eight fireships, defeated the Ottoman fleet of 51 vessels by attacking and burning with two fireships the Ottoman flagship—a 66-gun double-banked frigate—and another 34-gun frigate with another fireship." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4438380, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1825 battle between the Greek revolutionary fleet and the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
